response.title: Daily Airtable digest to Slack with n8n or Make
response.description:
Every morning our ops lead opens Airtable, filters yesterday's new orders and pastes a summary into Slack. We want this automated with n8n (preferred) or Make.

The digest should list yesterday's new orders, their total value and any order marked "urgent". It should post at 8:00 in #ops and skip weekends.

Start your proposal with the words "blue whale" so I know you read this. Proposals without it will be ignored.

instructions.text: Start your proposal with the words "blue whale" so I know you read this.
